description:
Delete a global section (Header/Footer/block) and remove its node from every page source.
Two-step safety: dry_run=true (default) shows which pages would change; dry_run=false performs the atomic save.

dry_run.description: Preview (true) or perform the delete + page cleanup (false).

section_id.description: The global section's section_id (the section node id) — from list_global_sections.

name: delete_global_section
